description: React component for a filter details popover in a dashboard, managing filter indicators, keyboard navigation, and popover visibility.

classes.name: DetailsPanelPopover
classes.description: React functional component for displaying filter indicators in a popover with keyboard navigation.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the popover, including arrow keys, Enter, Escape, and Tab.

methods.name: handleVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility state of the popover.

methods.name: indicatorKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for each indicator based on its column and name.
